periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented at approximately 45 degrees outward from the sagittal plane relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly elongated oval with a length-to-width ratio significantly greater than 1.0.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward and lateral tapering resulting in a tear-drop effect below the horizontal midpoint of the patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna gap is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear contour.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and generally rounded with a subtle degree of flattening at the highest point of the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-yellow discoloration or soil staining on the ventral fur of the lower abdominal region.
